name: browser-use
headline: claude skills vault for advanced workflows
short_description: A curated collection of high impact skills for Claude Code designed to supercharge the senior full stack workflow. This vault automates the repetitive parts of development like architectural reviews, TDD cycles, and PR management so you can stay in flow. It is a force multiplier for shipping clean, production ready code at scale.
author: georgekhananaev

sections.overview:
Claude Skills Vault is a repository of pre-built skills, commands, and MCP servers designed to extend Claude Code's capabilities across the full development stack. It includes 55 skills covering development, security, testing, frontend, backend, mobile, AI, databases, automation, and SEO, plus 11 commands for git workflows, PR management, and DevOps. Skills are installed directly into your project's .claude/skills/ directory using a simple CLI, with options to browse, search, preview, and install individually or in bulk. The vault reduces repetitive development tasks like architectural reviews, testing cycles, and release management, enabling teams to focus on high-impact work.
Automating architectural reviews and code quality checks
Streamlining test-driven development workflows
Managing pull requests and git workflows efficiently
Implementing security audits and OWASP compliance checks
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/georgekhananaev/claude-skills-vault`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a senior full stack developer and use the Claude Skills Vault to automate the following tasks for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector: [TASK 1], [TASK 2], and [TASK 3]. Provide a step-by-step plan to implement these tasks using the vault's capabilities, including architectural reviews, TDD cycles, and PR management.
```
Copy

